unit: Known source groups including conservative long-transcript proxies
method: Multinomial group resampling; inner resampling compresses groups with identical (TP,prediction) counts, which is distribution-exact
precision_intervals: Per-Cue marginal; not a simultaneous 42-Cue guarantee
stability_method: Each resample searches all tied-score-aware candidate thresholds and recomputes its Group Bootstrap precision LCB; fixed-threshold CI and selection stability are distinct
conditional_on: Fixed OOF calibration scores; nested group CV separately measures calibration and policy selection uncertainty
